project(ImtRestDemoServer LANGUAGES CXX)


if(APPLE)
	set(CMAKE_MACOSX_BUNDLE "off")
endif()

# The main file of the server (CImtRestDemoServer) is generated by ARXC from the partitura ImtRestDemoServer.acc,
# the packages of the partitura are searched in the directories of the configuration
set(ARXC_CONFIG "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../Config/ImtCore.awc")
set(ARXC_FILES "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/../${PROJECT_NAME}.acc")
set(ARXC_OUTDIR "${AUX_INCLUDE_DIR}")

include(${ACFDIR}/Config/CMake/CustomBuild.cmake)
include(${ACFDIR}/Config/CMake/ApplicationConfig.cmake)
include(${IMTCOREDIR}/Config/CMake/ImtCore.cmake)
include(${ACFDIR}/Config/CMake/DeployQt.cmake)

# The components of the packages that the partitura uses
target_link_libraries(${PROJECT_NAME} PRIVATE
	imtrestdemo
	imtrest
	imtcom
	Acf::iprm
	Acf::ifile
	Acf::ilog
)

deploy_qt(TARGET ${PROJECT_NAME})
